description: G.711 mu-law decode of one byte to a 16-bit linear sample
notes: Real-world telephony audio codec; function written by us from the G.711 expansion rule (invert, add the 0x84 bias to the mantissa, shift by the segment number, remove the bias, apply the sign). clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: 13 IR instructions, with a variable shift and a final select between t - 0x84 and 0x84 - t. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
